title: The feeling mind and the modern mind

statements.text: The conscious mind has a homeostatic component, the feeling mind, which continuously represents the state of life inside the organism, and a modern mind of later evolutionary vintage, made of exteroception, proprioception, reflection and their linguistic translation.

sources.quote: The homoeostatic component of the conscious mind constitutes a feeling mind.
we have proposed to call this latter process the modern mind because of its later evolutionary vintage
